Usage

Day-to-day with Vreckan — as a user and as an administrator.

Launching an application

  1. Sign in to the web client.
  2. Open the Apps view and pick an application from the installed list (or install one from a store).
  3. Configure any launch options you want to save as a preset, then launch.
  4. Vreckan spins up an isolated container and opens the app in a new tab through the secure session proxy. When you're done, end the session to free the resources.
Single-use URLs. Each session is reached through a unique, single-use URL that the server hands to your browser. The internal app container is never directly exposed to the internet.

Files & sharing

  • The Files view is a full file manager over your persistent home directory: create folders, upload, download, rename, and delete.
  • Open any file directly in a remote application with Open in app.
  • Share a file or folder with a public link — revoke it at any time. Expired shares are cleaned up automatically.
  • Multiple home directories can be configured, so different apps can see different slices of your storage.

For administrators

The admin area is a complete management dashboard, reachable from the sidebar. It is gated by fine-grained permissions, so you can grant exactly the control each person needs.

👥 People & Groups

Create and manage users, set passwords, assign groups, and map SSO groups to Vreckan roles.

🔑 Roles & Permissions

Define roles and assign the permission catalog — from admin.apps down to user.gpu.

📦 Apps & Stores

Install apps from stores, edit app definitions, and manage the app stores themselves.

🧩 Templates

Shape the per-app experience with templates and a configurable template schema.

🔌 Volume Mounts

Attach external volumes into app containers for shared or specialized storage.

💾 Backup & Restore

Snapshot and restore the entire configuration database on a schedule or on demand.

🔐 SSO / OIDC

Connect an identity provider (authentik, Keycloak, Entra ID, …) and map its groups to admins and users.

📜 Certificates

Issue and renew Let's Encrypt certificates, and view the current certificate's status and expiry.

Sessions & the laboratory

Admins can see every live session across the platform and stop any of them. The Laboratory gives a live console into a running session for hands-on debugging.
